task: Turn this into a clean payroll correction request and set out the working for the extra gross pay owed as missing hours x 1.5 x hourly rate.
text:
Subject: Pay correction, October run

Hi Payroll team,

Employee Chiamaka Eze (employee ID E-30871, work email chiamaka.eze@example.net) was underpaid for October. She raised it with me on 3 November. She worked 14 hours of overtime at 1.5x, but only 9 hours were paid. Her hourly rate is 22.40 pounds. Please add the missing 5 hours at 1.5x to the November run, not as an off-cycle payment. Her line manager, Gustavo Pinheiro, approved the timesheet on 29 October. I checked it twice: the 14 hours are all on Saturdays. Do not change her base pay or her bank details. Ticket HR-5521 has the screenshots.

Thanks,
Mirela Dragan, HR Operations
